crossRefs.note: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so Yahweh your God disciplines you.

“Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.
When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.”
He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.

There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way: whoever hates reproof shall die.
He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
Folly is bound up in the heart of a child: the rod of discipline drives it far from him.

translations.web: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.
translations.bsb: Those I love I rebuke and discipline. Therefore be earnest and repent.
